findings.claim: retry() now assigns a new random task_id instead of reusing the original, directly violating the documented retry-dedup contract.
findings.failure_scenario: A task with task_id 'abc123' fails and retry(queue, task) is called; task.task_id is overwritten with a freshly generated uuid, so downstream consumers that dedupe completed work by task_id see the retried attempt as unrelated new work instead of a retry of 'abc123', breaking dedup and any tracking keyed on the original id.
